subject.title: Control UI: Memory panel for MEMORY.md and USER.md

question: Should OpenClaw add a core Control UI memory editor for `USER.md`, root `MEMORY.md`, and daily memory notes now, or wait for broader workspace-file and plugin contribution-slot designs?
rationale: The missing functionality changes browser access to prompt-influencing persistent state and overlaps active workspace CRUD and plugin UI design threads, so code alone cannot choose the permanent product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve Narrow Core Memory Panel
options.body: Add a small core surface that edits only reviewed memory files and date-scoped daily notes with explicit authorization, path validation, and UI proof.

options.title: Defer To Plugin Contribution Slots
options.body: Keep the issue behind the Control UI contribution-slot RFC so a memory/context plugin can contribute a host-rendered panel without adding another core UI contract now.

options.title: Fold Into Workspace CRUD
options.body: Treat the memory panel as a specialized view on top of the broader workspace file-management effort once the workspace API security model is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Core Memory Panel
recommendation.body: Add a small core surface that edits only reviewed memory files and date-scoped daily notes with explicit authorization, path validation, and UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current workspace browsing boundary and are the strongest history signal for the related gateway/control UI file-access decision.
